vector_memory.semantic_summary: This FastAPI router component manages all API endpoints for user-defined prompts, acting as the primary controller layer for prompt persistence. It exposes CRUD operations for prompts, relying heavily on the `prompt_manager` service to handle filesystem interactions. It translates specific service layer exceptions (like NotFound or InvalidPath) into appropriate HTTP status codes for external clients.
